description: This file defines a set of functions and callbacks for generating indented JSON structures within a CMake build system. It includes functions for handling JSON objects, arrays, key-value pairs, and literals with indentation, as well as setting up callback tables and a main function to initiate the process.

methods.name: json_indented
methods.description: Main function that initializes the JSON indentation process, sets up callback functions, and executes the JSON indentation generation based on provided arguments.
